description: Flat sample-level metadata schema for 18S rRNA amplicon sequencing of airborne microbial communities collected across urban environments with associated air quality measurements.

sample_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual air-sample record.

collection_date.descr: Date when the air sample was collected (ISO 8601 format, e.g. 2026-03-15).

collection_time.descr: Local time of sample collection start or midpoint, if recorded (24-hour format, e.g. 14:30).

time_zone.descr: Time zone for the sampling time, if applicable (e.g. UTC, UTC+1).

city.descr: City where the sample was collected.

country.descr: Country where the sample was collected.

site_name.descr: Specific sampling site name or code within the city.

site_type.descr: Urban land-use category of the sampling location; expected values include industrial, park, residential, commercial, roadside, or other.

latitude.descr: Latitude of the sampling location in decimal degrees (WGS84).

longitude.descr: Longitude of the sampling location in decimal degrees (WGS84).

altitude_m.descr: Sampling site elevation above sea level in meters, if known.

season.descr: Season during which the sample was collected; expected values include spring, summer, autumn/fall, and winter.

weather_condition.descr: Brief description of ambient weather during sampling (e.g. clear, rainy, cloudy, windy).

temperature_c.descr: Ambient air temperature during sampling in degrees Celsius.

relative_humidity_pct.descr: Relative humidity during sampling in percent (%).

wind_speed_m_s.descr: Wind speed during sampling in meters per second (m/s), if measured.

particulate_matter_pm2_5_ug_m3.descr: Concentration of particulate matter with aerodynamic diameter ≤2.5 µm in micrograms per cubic meter (µg/m3).

particulate_matter_pm10_ug_m3.descr: Concentration of particulate matter with aerodynamic diameter ≤10 µm in micrograms per cubic meter (µg/m3).

sampling_device.descr: Air sampling device or sampler model used to collect airborne material (e.g. filter sampler, impinger, cyclone).

sampling_medium.descr: Collection medium used for capture (e.g. filter type, membrane material, liquid medium).

filter_pore_size_um.descr: Filter pore size in micrometers (µm), if a filter-based sampler was used.

sampling_duration_min.descr: Duration of air sampling in minutes.

air_volume_m3.descr: Total volume of air sampled in cubic meters (m3).

flow_rate_l_min.descr: Sampler flow rate in liters per minute (L/min), if available.

replicate_id.descr: Technical or biological replicate identifier for the sample, if applicable.

dna_extraction_method.descr: DNA extraction kit or protocol used for the sample.

target_gene.descr: Amplified marker gene; for this study it should be 18S rRNA.

amplicon_region.descr: Region of the 18S rRNA gene amplified (e.g. V4, V9).

primer_forward.descr: Forward primer sequence used for amplification.

primer_reverse.descr: Reverse primer sequence used for amplification.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing instrument or platform used (e.g. Illumina MiSeq, NovaSeq).

library_preparation_method.descr: Library preparation workflow used for sequencing.

read_length_bp.descr: Sequencing read length in base pairs (bp) for a single read.

reference_database.descr: Taxonomic reference database used for assignment (e.g. SILVA, PR2) and version if known.

sequence_quality_passed.descr: Whether the sample passed quality control/filtering for downstream analysis.

taxonomic_summary.descr: Optional high-level taxonomic summary of the sample, if precomputed (e.g. major groups detected).

public_health_context.descr: Optional annotation describing any public-health-relevant context for the site or sampling event.

notes.descr: Additional free-text notes on sampling conditions, anomalies, or deviations from protocol.
